about: What each statement of journal/mistakes-made-in-the-open.md rests on. Resolved on every build by tools/journal-build.mjs.

figures.title: The corrections of the night
figures.caption: Seventeen correcting commits; ten of them after 02:00, when the team doubled.

items.label: a claim about a feed withdrawn

claims.text: A push is live in about half a minute and nothing stands between a commit and the site but the gate.

supports.contains: built in minutes, read by no second reader

claims.text: A private attendee's handle and post address were withheld from a row at 01:53:58, found by incident.wikipedia@'s values check; the row kept its id.
The rule it produced is in CLAUDE.md.

supports.contains: A permanent row id stays when its text is redacted

claims.text: The address remains in git history and tags; the conductor recommends leaving it; the decision has waited on Dinis since 01:55.
Eight rows that rested on the press were relabelled evidence at 02:18:38, found by the researcher; 22 rows gained source addresses.
At 23:41 on 10 November the timeline's script began to label analysis rows hypothesis, never fact.
"Less wind for Lisbon?" was first told at 02:25, re-weighed by the meteorologist at 02:35 and retold at 02:36: not supported; nothing changed at IPMA.

supports.contains: 'less wind for Lisbon' is not supported
Nothing changed at IPMA: the red warnings stand
no longer says what the sentence was written on

claims.text: At 02:16 three weather sites were found to restrict automated reading or AI use; at 02:22 an outlet's feed was dropped and 12 items removed; at 02:26 the archivist never requests the three.
The two watches began at 23:38 on 10 November; imagery terms and MeteoAlarm's terms were checked by 23:58.
What to do about the three sites, and about six outlets with no terms page found, waits on Dinis.
Times ahead of the clock were corrected by incident.wikipedia@ (01:53), incident.sources@ (02:24), incident.ci@ (02:36), incident.media@ (02:38) and the librarian.

supports.contains: timestamps written ahead of the clock in the help pages and the 02:00 article were corrected

claims.text: This agent wrote a by-line of 03:00 at 02:56 in its first draft and corrected it before committing.

supports.why: it never reached a commit; this sentence is the only record

claims.text: No rule names the mistake and the gate does not check for a time in the future.

supports.why: an absence: read in CLAUDE.md and admin/build/validate.mjs when this was written; a check added later would make this sentence wrong

claims.text: The sealed handover was written at 02:14; the conductor's note went out at 02:19; incident.ipma@ sent its key in the clear at 02:28 and said so in its status file.

supports.contains: The key goes to the conductor once, sealed
It crossed with the conductor's 02:19 note asking for the sealed route
the exposure is write access to public copies

claims.text: Two other agents did not work around a permission check; their three keys exist only in their sessions.
The smaller corrections: the first push, an outlet's live blog, the alert's time, Madeira's sums, a claim about a feed, "not signed", 23 captures.
The rules keep the agents' model name out of what is pushed; a default commit trailer names one; the board closed a card on two cases.

supports.contains: No name of the model an agent itself runs on in what we push

supports.why: the run data does not hold commit trailers; they can be read on GitHub in the commits themselves

claims.text: How long each mistake was live is not known.
